name: Wrong History
premise: A breathless amateur historian presents history that starts completely true and then quietly derails into invented lore. Every episode is framed as a fact nobody told you. The narrator's escalating obsession is the ongoing character.
art_style: hyperreal AI photograph, uncanny oversaturated realism, archival photo look with slightly wrong anatomy and impossible architecture, dramatic golden hour lighting, shallow depth of field, faintly plastic skin, vertical composition
voice_note: Fast, conspiratorial, leaning into the camera. Sounds like she is telling you a secret she should not know.
script_guidelines: Beat one must be a real, verifiable historical fact. Earn trust before spending it.
Beat two bends it. Beat three is openly impossible. The viewer should not be able to name the exact moment it broke.
Anchor everything in dates, place names and numbers. Specificity is what makes it funny.
The narrator fully believes it and is slightly upset that nobody else does.
The video must be obviously comedic fiction by the end. Never leave a plausible false claim as the final line.
End by daring the viewer to look it up.
disclaimer: Satire. This is fiction, not history.
